feature.title: Fix Cloud Function bugs in dispatch-webhook, enforce-timer-limit, and oauth-token-exchange

tasks.title: Fix dispatch-webhook.js: undefined sub variable and O(n) hostId scan
tasks.description: In dispatchWithRetry(), `sub` is referenced on line 103 but never defined in scope. It exists only in the calling function's for...of loop. Fix: thread hostId through as a parameter instead of the O(n) hostIdFromSid scan. Pass hostId (already available from Object.entries loop) directly. Also fix deliveryCount: pass current sub.deliveryCount as parameter or read from DB snapshot at function start.
acceptanceCriteria: dispatchWithRetry signature: (url, payload, secret, sid, hostId, deliveryCount, db)
hostId thread through from caller's Object.entries(subscriptions) loop
hostIdFromSid function DELETED (no longer needed)
deliveryCount properly incremented: deliveryCount + 1 not (undefined || 0) + 1
lastDelivery and lastResponseCode update uses correct path: /webhook_subscriptions/${hostId}/${sid}
No regression: webhook dispatch still works end-to-end

tasks.title: Fix enforce-timer-limit.js: add scheduled trigger for periodic timer check
tasks.description: Current trigger `onValueWritten('/workspaces/{wid}/timers/current/startTime')` only fires ONCE when timer starts. Timer never auto-stops because startTime isn't rewritten. Fix: add a scheduled Cloud Function (onSchedule every 5 minutes) that queries all running timers and checks elapsed time. Alternative: use onValueWritten on a heartbeat field that the client writes periodically, or use Cloud Tasks to schedule a check at startTime + 8h.
acceptanceCriteria: Timer auto-stops at 8h elapsed (MAX_TIMER_HOURS) regardless of when startTime was written
Timer hard-stops at 12h (HARD_CAP_HOURS)
Warning notification written at 7h (WARNING_HOURS)
Idempotent: won't double-stop an already stopped timer
Scheduled function reads all workspaces with running timers, checks elapsed time
Scheduled function respects Firebase read quotas (batched reads, not individual per workspace)
Log entry written to /workspaces/{wid}/timers/log/ on auto-stop
Clear log message identifying auto-stop vs manual stop

tasks.title: Fix oauth-token-exchange.js: validate ENCRYPTION_KEY at function entry, not just module load
tasks.description: Module load does console.error if OAUTH_ENCRYPTION_KEY is missing but continues execution. When encryptTokens() is called later, Buffer.from(undefined, 'hex') throws TypeError. Fix: validate ENCRYPTION_KEY at function entry (before any logic), return 500 with clear error. Also add startup validation that throws to prevent deployment without the key.
acceptanceCriteria: encryptTokens() validates ENCRYPTION_KEY before use, throws clear error if missing
decryptTokens() validates ENCRYPTION_KEY before use, throws clear error if missing
HTTP handler returns 500 with 'Server configuration error' if key missing (not TypeError crash)
Module-level check upgraded from console.error to throwing during cold start (prevents deploy)
Error message includes 'OAUTH_ENCRYPTION_KEY' in text for ops visibility

tasks.title: Fix book-slot.js: replace Math.random() with crypto.randomUUID() for booking/workspace IDs
tasks.description: randomId() uses Math.random() which is not cryptographically secure. While booking IDs don't require crypto-level entropy, they are used in URLs and access patterns. Use crypto.randomUUID() for collision-resistant, non-guessable IDs.
acceptanceCriteria: randomId() replaced with crypto.randomUUID() or crypto.getRandomValues()
Booking ID format: 'bkg_' + 8 hex chars from crypto
Workspace ID format: 'ws_' + 6 hex chars from crypto
No Math.random() usage in Cloud Functions

tasks.title: Add retry logic to book-slot.js for transient Firebase transaction failures
tasks.description: The booking transaction uses maxRetries: 0 by design (slot-taken should fail fast). But transient Firebase errors (network blips, server busy) shouldn't fail the booking. Add distinction: transaction conflict (slot_taken) → fail fast. Transient error (network, server) → retry once with 1s backoff.
acceptanceCriteria: Transaction conflict (slot_taken, slot_missing) → fail fast, no retry
Transient Firebase error → 1 retry with 1s backoff
Max 2 total attempts (1 initial + 1 retry)
Both attempts logged with attempt number
No retry on validation errors (400-level)
15s total timeout across both attempts
